info: MASTER REFERENCE EXPANDED - File 05 - Daily Life & Shopping

words.pinyin: Shuì bāohán zài nèi le ma?

words.zh: 你们的退货政策是什么？
words.pinyin: Nǐmen de tuìhuò zhèngcè shì shénme?

words.en: Do you have this in my size?
words.pinyin: Zhège yǒu wǒ de chǐmǎ ma?

words.zh: 我可以用这张优惠券吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ yòng zhè zhāng yōuhuìquàn ma?

words.zh: 请控制在我们的预算内。
words.pinyin: Qǐng kòngzhì zài wǒmen de yùsuàn nèi

words.en: Could you double-check the price at the register?
words.zh: 能在收银台复核一下价格吗？
words.pinyin: Néng zài shōuyíntái fùhé yīxià jiàgé ma?

words.en: I'm comparing a few options online before I buy
words.zh: 我买之前想在网上比较几个选项。
words.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi zhīqián xiǎng zài wǎngshàng bǐjiào jǐ gè xuǎnxiàng

words.en: Can you hold this item for the next two hours?
words.zh: 可以帮我保留这件商品两小时吗？
words.pinyin: Kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎoliú zhè jiàn shāngpǐn liǎng xiǎoshí ma?

words.en: Is there a student discount available?
Could you email me the receipt as well?
words.zh: 可以把收据也发邮件给我吗？
words.pinyin: Kěyǐ bǎ shōujù yě fā yóujiàn gěi wǒ ma?

words.en: How do I get to the station?

words.zh: 最近的公交车站在哪里？
words.pinyin: Zuìjìn de gōngjiāochē zhàn zài nǎlǐ?

words.en: Are you going to the library?

words.zh: 别客气，像在自己家一样。
words.pinyin: Bié kèqì, xiàng zài zìjǐ jiā yíyàng

words.en: I have to run a few errands
words.pinyin: Wǒ děi qù bàn diǎn shì

words.en: Can you sign for this package?
words.pinyin: Nín néng qiānshōu zhège bāoguǒ ma?

words.en: Please remind me about the appointment
words.zh: 请提醒我关于预约的事。
words.pinyin: Qǐng tíxǐng wǒ guānyú yùyuē de shì

words.en: I left a note for the landlord
words.pinyin: Wǒ gěi fángdōng liú le zhāng biàntiáo

words.en: We need to recycle these bottles
words.zh: 我们需要回收这些瓶子。

words.en: Can you help me with the meter reading?
words.pinyin: Nín néng bāng wǒ chāobiǎo ma?

words.en: Can you water the plants while I'm away?
words.zh: 我不在的时候您能帮我浇花吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒ bú zài de shíhou nín néng bāng wǒ jiāohuā ma?

words.en: Let's set up a cleaning schedule for the week
words.zh: 我们制定这周的清洁计划吧。
words.pinyin: Wǒmen zhìdìng zhè zhōu de qīngjié jìhuà ba

words.en: Please remind me to pay the rent on Friday
words.pinyin: Qǐng tíxǐng wǒ Zhōuwǔ fù fángzū

words.en: Can we share the cost of new furniture?
words.zh: 我们可以分摊新家具的费用吗？
words.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ fēntān xīn jiājù de fèiyòng ma?

words.en: I'll message you when I'm almost home
words.zh: 我快到家时给您发信息。
words.pinyin: Wǒ kuài dào jiā shí gěi nín fā xìnxī
